asset.label: BC Railway Company — Website wordmark
asset.sourceLocator: Site logo PNG (236 × 124); fitted to the 485 × 250 version of the same artwork in the Wayback Machine’s 8 July 2022 capture (wp1/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/cropped-bcrco_logo.png)
asset.dateNote: Website artwork, undated; seen on the site from 2022 to 2026.
asset.notes: The BCRC acrostic as the Company’s website shows it: British Columbia Railway Company stepped down on four lines in a heavy humanist italic, initials red and the rest blue.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork: no vector of this lettering was found on bcrco.com or in 63 archived Company PDFs. The 29 letters are Source Sans 3 Italic (weight 800) outlines with one shared widening (about 118%) and added slant (about 4°), each letter placed to the 485-px capture (silhouette overlap about 0.84 there, 0.79 against the 236-px file). Source Sans 3 is a free match in the Myriad manner; the original typeface is not verified. The web image’s thin white edge is left out. Red #E10C14 and blue #29388C are sampled.

asset.label: PGE Point Ellice diamond monogram
asset.sourceLocator: The Cariboo, Issue 3, January 1991, PDF page 5 (the registered 300-dpi crop)
asset.dateNote: January 1991 dates the published illustration this follows, not the mark’s introduction or use.
asset.notes: A tall diamond outline around a ring and an interlaced monoline P, G, E and R, as illustrated for the steam tug Point Ellice.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the diamond and ring are fitted to both edges of the printed lines, and the P-G-E-R monogram is drawn by hand as monoline strokes (lines and arcs), checked by overlay (overlap 0.88). No tracing and no type. Near-black, as illustrated; the article’s medium-dark green on white is not applied.

asset.label: PGE square diamond, unshaded
asset.sourceLocator: The Cariboo, Issue 3, January 1991, PDF page 5 (the registered 300-dpi crop)
asset.dateNote: January 1991 dates the published illustration this follows, not the mark’s introduction or use.
asset.notes: A square diamond with an inner diamond broken at the ring, around an interlaced Roman P, G and E, as illustrated for steam crane 6071.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the outer diamond, the four corners of the inner diamond and the ring are fitted lines and circles; the interlaced monogram is an automatic outline (potrace, from the illustration upsampled ×4) used as drawn, not hand-redrawn. Overall overlap 0.91. One colour, as illustrated; the article qualifies the colour.

asset.label: PGE early caribou equipment herald
asset.sourceLocator: The Cariboo, Issue 3, January 1991, PDF page 7 (the registered 300-dpi crop)
asset.dateNote: January 1991 dates the published illustration this follows, not the mark’s introduction or use.
asset.notes: PACIFIC GREAT EASTERN RLY in a condensed gothic between two heavy rings, a caribou head in the centre.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the rings are fitted circles; the lettering is Oswald Bold outlines, each letter placed and turned to the illustration (mean letter overlap 0.81 and 0.79 for the two runs of lettering); Oswald is a free condensed-gothic match and the original lettering is not verified. The caribou is an automatic outline (potrace, from the 300-dpi illustration upsampled ×4, specks under 40 px removed) used as drawn, not hand-redrawn; overall overlap 0.86.
